description: Kumi's techniques: ideas behind sounds Kumi built that the producer chose to keep, to adapt for the same kind of sound later (a recipe, by contrast, replays exact steps). action draft: when something you built is a reusable idea for a kind of sound (not a one-off, a routine change, a fix or work toward a goal), draft it in the same reply as the make_changes that builds it: its name, what it fits (narrowly: the kind of sound, such as "glassy FM plucks", not "synths"), the idea (the chain and why each part), the settings that mattered, substitutes (what to use when a part isn't available, such as a plugin or a step Kumi can't do), and where it came from (a tutorial's title and address). After your answer Kumi asks the producer whether to keep it; don't ask or mention it yourself. When it refines a technique you read, pass replaces with its id. action keep: with those fields, keeps one at once, only when the producer asks in so many words to remember how something was done, or to change a technique (with replaces); with no other fields, keeps the technique Kumi offered, when the producer's message says yes to keeping it. action read: the whole of a technique listed in your instructions, when the producer asks for it, or when a request leaves the approach open and is about the kind of sound it fits; not when they give a tutorial, a reference or steps to follow. Then adapt it and say you're using it. action forget: remove one when the producer asks.

After your answer Kumi asks the producer whether to keep it; don't ask or mention it. Leave it out for one-off or routine changes and fixes.
